2607.24492.title: SINT-Flow: Schema Integration using Large Language Model Workflows
2607.24492.paper_summary: The goal of schema integration is, given a set of input schemata or tables, to derive a global, unified schema that is able to represent the concepts, attributes, and relationships of all input tables in a coherent fashion. This paper presents SINT-Flow, a schema integration framework composed of five LLM-based operators that can be combined into workflows to perform fully automated, end-to-end schema integration. In contrast to existing approaches, SINT-Flow can process denormalized source tables that contain attributes describing multiple entity types. During the schema integration process, these tables are decomposed into separate entity-specific relations. To evaluate SINT-Flow, we introduce SINT-Bench, a schema integration benchmark comprising 10 schema integration tasks consisting of altogether 93 relational tables, including tables that describe multiple types of entities. We evaluate SINT-Flow using GPT-5.2 as well as the open-weight model Qwen-3.6-27B as alternative backbone models. Using these models, SINT-Flow achieves F1 scores of at least 96% for entity-type detection, 85% for attribute detection, and 83% for schema mapping. Furthermore, we perform an ablation study to prove the utility of the applied self-consistency strategy as well as the inclusion of a review loop into the schema matching operator.
2607.24492.paper_summary_zh: 目標是對給定的一組輸入模式或表格進行模式整合，推導出一個全球統一的模式，能夠以連貫的方式表示所有輸入表格的概念、屬性和關係。本文介紹了 SINT-Flow，一個由五個基於 LLM 的操作符組成的模式整合框架，這些操作符可以組合成工作流程，實現完全自動化的端到端模式整合。與現有方法相比，SINT-Flow 能夠處理包含描述多種實體類型的屬性的非正規化源表格。在模式整合過程中，這些表格被分解為單獨的實體特定關係。為了評估 SINT-Flow，我們引入了 SINT-Bench，一個包含 10 個模式整合任務的基準，這些任務總共包括 93 個關聯表格，其中包括描述多種類型實體的表格。我們使用 GPT-5.2 以及開放權重模型 Qwen-3.6-27B 作為替代主幹模型來評估 SINT-Flow。使用這些模型，SINT-Flow 在實體類型檢測中達到至少 96% 的 F1 分數，在屬性檢測中達到 85%，在模式映射中達到 83%。此外，我們進行了消融研究，以證明所應用的自我一致性策略的效用，以及將審查循環納入模式匹配操作符的價值。
2607.24492.author: Keti Korini et.al.
